dedupe_keys.name: arrival trajectories at five major european airports ads b 2019

description: This dataset contains ADS-B arrival trajectories at five major European airports, Amsterdam Schiphol, Dublin, London City, London Heathrow and Paris Charles de Gaulle, for October and November 2019. Each airport has one Parquet file with positional information, derived quantities and a unique identifier for each trajectory, from about 130 MB (London City) to 460 MB compressed. The data were first used to evaluate the environmental impact of arrival procedures and are offered for other air transport research. Coverage is the terminal airspace of the five airports over two months. Access: free download from 4TU.ResearchData under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, published in August 2022 by Xavier Olive, Luis Basora and Junzi Sun. Caveats: the licence bars commercial use, the period is short and pre-pandemic, and ADS-B coverage gaps can truncate trajectories. It supports terminal airspace capacity and arrival sequencing studies, calibration of airport and airspace simulation models and environmental analysis of approaches, and complements the OpenSky Network and airport ground movement benchmarks catalogued here.
name: Arrival trajectories at five major European airports (ADS-B, 2019)
